hookups.source: recreation.gov 232687 ('63 sites with water and electric hook up') + RIDB catalog (all 60 reservable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes; no sewer attribute on any site), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 60 reservable water/50 A electric sites (59 take 25 ft or more; site lengths 20-50 ft; 27 pull-through) plus 6 non-electric sites (043-048) listed for tents and trailers with no length; 3 more electric sites are staff/host sites.

sites.source: RIDB catalog for 232687 (60 STANDARD ELECTRIC reservable, 6 STANDARD NONELECTRIC reservable, 3 MANAGEMENT not reservable; Max Vehicle Length 20-50; Driveway Entry Pull-Through 27 / Back-In 36), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: recreation.gov 232687 Facilities ('two bathhouses that have flush toilets and showers', 'two dump stations'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Open spring to early September; the dates shift each year (2026: Mar 27 - Sep 13; 2027: Apr 2 - Sep 11).

season.source: recreation.gov rates for 232687 (Peak Season 2026-03-27 to 2026-09-13, 2027-04-02 to 2027-09-11, the only season priced) + availability (Nov 2026 every site 'Not Available'; Jan/Mar 2027 no dates; first bookable night 2027-04-02), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Water/electric sites $32 a night in 2026 and 2027 (double sites $64). The six non-electric sites, $22, are listed for tents and trailers with no length given.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232687/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD ELECTRIC 32, double-unit 64, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 22) + RIDB catalog (non-electric sites 043-048 equipment TENT/TRAILER, Max Vehicle Length 0), read 2026-10-29

values.note: All payments through recreation.gov; camp hosts can't take payment. Bookable through the day of arrival. 3-night minimum on holiday weekends; 14 nights in any rolling 30 days. Gates 7 am - 10 pm, code given at check-in.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232687 (fee description 'All payments and fees will occur through recreation.gov, on site camp hosts cannot process payments'; facility_rules minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days, reservationCutOff 0; gate notice), read 2026-10-29

summary: recreation.gov + RIDB: USACE Savannah District campground on a peninsula in Thurmond Lake; 60 reservable water/50 A sites (20-50 ft, 59 take 25 ft+, 27 pull-through) plus 6 non-electric tent/trailer sites; showers, two dump stations; $32 a night for the electric sites in 2026 and 2027 (stored low $22 was the non-electric tent/trailer rate - raised to $32, the cheapest site listing RVs); open about Apr - mid-Sep; 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max. Pin matches the per-site centroid (68 m). AWH note kept verbatim (rec.gov: 'located on a scenic peninsula surrounded by the J. Strom Thurmond Lake'; 'All shorelines adjacent to campsites are public property').
